hints.title: Row Scanning
hints.text: Iterate through each row of the matrix and count the number of ones.

hints.title: Tracking Best Row Index
hints.text: Keep track of the maximum count of ones encountered and the corresponding row index.

hints.title: Tie-Breaking Rule
hints.text: Only update the best index when the current row's count is strictly greater than the maximum count so far.

hints.title: Row Counting Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: All elements must be inspected to count occurrences.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Performs single scan and applies strict inequality for tie-breaking.
